references.text: Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel on his two shoulders as a reminder before the Lord, the same concept of bearing the names as a reminder.
The twelve stones on the breastpiece represent the twelve sons of Israel, which Aaron bears upon his heart.
Fulfillment of the instruction to bear the names of the sons of Israel as a reminder.
Aaron enters the sanctuary, parallel to the priestly service described in Exodus 28:29.
Twelve stones as a memorial for the sons of Israel, with a function similar to that of the breastpiece.
The Lord has engraved his people on his hands, parallel to how Aaron bears the names of the people upon his heart.
Set me as a seal upon your heart, the image of carrying someone close to one's heart as a reminder.
Jesus as our high priest enters the sanctuary for us, fulfilling what Aaron did by bearing the people on his heart.
Christ entered into heaven itself to appear before God on our behalf, fulfilling the role that Aaron had in bearing the people as a reminder.
Christ Jesus intercedes for us, parallel to Aaron's role as mediator and intercessor.
Parallel function in the priest's service: the breastpiece bears the names as a reminder, while the plate bears the guilt of holy gifts.
